G001.target_statement: Receive job postings for roles specific to the stakeholder's domain, such as software engineering or machine learning roles.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句以 'I would like to get' 直接表达接收领域内岗位的愿望，主体为受访者，对象为岗位，限定为软件工程/机器学习等领域；未虚构数量或时间。
supported_parts: 结果：接收特定领域岗位
限定：软件工程或机器学习等领域

G002.target_statement: Receive job updates matched to the stakeholder's skill set.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T003 明确以 'based on whatever is my skill set' 作为更新条件，T091 以算法按兴趣与技能集匹配并给出必要岗位作佐证；未设定匹配阈值（原文的百分比只是受访者现有工具做法，未进入本目标）。
supported_parts: 结果：接收相应岗位更新

G003.target_statement: While actively looking for a job, receive a job update at the instant the job is posted on the platform.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 'it would be great if I receive at the instant. The job is like posted in the platform' 明确即时性，并由 'if I'm actually looking for Job' 限定情境；强度为 'would be great' 的偏好，未升级为必须。
supported_parts: 结果：岗位发布即时收到更新

G004.target_statement: While not actively looking for a job, receive job updates once a week.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 'then it's okay to receive once in a week' 表达非活跃期的可接受频率；强度为 'okay to'（可接受），已在表述与理由中保留，未改写成必须每周一次。

G005.target_statement: Receive job updates by email, preferably a professional email.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 'I would generally prefer getting via emails' 给出渠道偏好，'professional emails' 进一步限定邮件形式；'generally prefer' 的可让步强度被保留。

G006.target_statement: Avoid mobile job notifications that are too complicated or that fill up the notification tab.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 'unless it's like too complicated. And it's like filling all my notification tab' 以否定条件表达对移动端通知过载的规避；未编造数量上限或具体阈值。
supported_parts: 规避：过于复杂、占满通知栏

G007.target_statement: Receive a concise email that carries the necessary job details.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 'the email should be very concise' 与 'All the details are present in the email' 均指向邮件内容要求（简洁且含必要细节）；两处同属一条内容要求，未增加具体字段清单。
supported_parts: 内容：必要岗位细节齐备

G008.target_statement: Apply directly with a single quick apply action available in the email or on the job update, instead of navigating to the app and then the company's portal.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: T009 明确 'direct apply button in the email itself' 及避免两次跳转的目的；T099 的 'quick, apply button' 是同一快速申请诉求的另一次表达，合并后两处触发面均保留，未扩大到自动投递。
supported_parts: 动作：在邮件/岗位更新处直接申请
方式：直接申请或快速申请按钮
结果：不跳转到应用与公司门户

G009.target_statement: See employee reviews, the team's current work and tech stack, and how the applicant would contribute, in the job information.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句逐项列出在岗评价、团队在做的工作、所用技术以及本人如何贡献，属对岗位信息内容的要求；'text' 按上下文理解为技术栈，见 limitations。
assumptions: 'what text they are using' 指团队使用的技术（tech），为转写噪声

G010.target_statement: View job details such as the tech stack in a list, card or table layout that is easy to navigate.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原句以 'formatted in terms of list cars and tables' 选定列表/卡片/表格三种形式，并说明目的是便于浏览技术栈等细节；'cars' 按卡片（cards）理解，见 limitations。
supported_parts: 结果：便于浏览技术栈细节

G011.target_statement: Receive job updates that are relevant to the stakeholder, so that important jobs are not missed among irrelevant ones.
G011.label: inferred
G011.rationale: 由 T025 的群发导致错过、T027 的后果与 T055 的不相关列表三处正面依据推断'只接收相关更新'；原文未给出相关性判定标准（是否用技能匹配度等未定），因此未在目标中写阈值。
supported_parts: 结果：更新与受访者相关
动机：避免重要岗位被淹没
assumptions: 抱怨可正面推断为相关性要求
reasoning_steps: T025 记录群发几乎所有岗位且部分不相关
T027 记录因此错过重要岗位
T055 记录不相关列表引发沮丧
合并推断出对相关更新的期望

G012.target_statement: Have AI identify jobs that fit the stakeholder's interests and skill set.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: T093 在'AI 功能是否必要'的语境下回答识别岗位 'will be great'；T081 明确 AI 功能 'really great to have'；T091 说明按兴趣与技能集匹配的机制。三处共同支持以 AI 识别合适岗位，未扩展到撰写申请。
supported_parts: 依据：兴趣与技能集匹配

G013.target_statement: See work-eligibility information such as visa status and experience-based eligibility for a posting.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 该句出现在'如何定义相关岗位'的回答中，签证/资格与经验是否满足被列为考虑项；目标只保留信息可见，未指定展示位置或门槛。
supported_parts: 内容：基于经验的任职资格

G014.target_statement: Have the job list generated from the stakeholder's profile (experience, skills, projects) so that no additional filters are needed.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句以 'I kinda assume' 表述期待：提供岗位列表时已按经验与技能集设定，无需再加筛选；语气为假设性期待，已在 rationale 说明，未改写为强制要求。
supported_parts: 来源：档案中的经验与技能
结果：无需追加筛选条件
assumptions: 'I kinda assume' 视为对系统行为的期待

G015.target_statement: Customize a few job-search keywords in the profile to get relevant results.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: T041 提出可定制少量关键词以获得相关结果，T043 确认希望定制放在档案中；'few'（少量）与'profile'位置均保留。
supported_parts: 能力：定制少量搜索关键词

G016.target_statement: Mark a job as uninterested or blacklist it so that it stops appearing.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句描述现有拉黑/标记不感兴趣的做法，并明确希望该岗位不再出现；期望结果（不再出现）直接可读，未扩展到全部推荐机制。
supported_parts: 动作：标记不感兴趣/拉黑

G017.target_statement: View the company's job portal in an integrated in-page view inside the app.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 采访者提出'公司岗位门户的页内视图是否更可能促成申请'，受访者答 'that would be really great to have integrated'，属明确正面采纳；是否成为实现责任未定。
supported_parts: 结果：应用内页内查看公司门户
assumptions: 'integrated' 指把公司门户嵌入应用内页

G018.target_statement: Transfer the details from the job portal to the company's website automatically.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句以 'I would also prefer' 表达把平台内资料转移到公司网站的偏好；'those reviews' 为转写噪声，不改变转移细节的核心含义（见 limitations）。
supported_parts: 动作：转移岗位/个人资料
assumptions: 'those reviews' 属转写噪声，不构成第四方对象

G019.target_statement: Avoid random job notifications and random people reaching out to the stakeholder.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 该句回答'什么原因会让你不想用岗位应用'，把随机岗位通知与随机陌生人联系列为原因，属规避意图；未推断为禁止一切通知。

G020.target_statement: Exclude job postings that are six months to a year old or older.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 'I don't want to apply for jobs which are like one year back, or even 6 months back' 给出明确时间范围与拒斥态度；阈值沿用原文表述，不额外精确为天数。
supported_parts: 范围：发布六个月至一年及以上
结果：不呈现或不予申请

G021.target_statement: Avoid manual re-entry of details already provided in the resume or configured in the profile.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: T073 把重复填写简历已有信息视为障碍（费时费力），T081 把档案配置应当持久、无需再改作为优点；两处同属'不要重复录入'的结果，合并后保留简历与档案两个来源。
supported_parts: 规避：重复填写简历已有信息
规避：重复修改已配置的档案

G022.target_statement: Customize application details for a few specific job roles.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句明确'有时'希望针对'少数'岗位定制资料，范围与频率均保留，未推广为所有申请都必须定制。
supported_parts: 能力：按岗位定制申请资料

G023.target_statement: Save interesting job postings for later tracking inside the job portal itself.
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: T075 描述现状是记下岗位号到单独文档/Notion，T077 明确希望这类功能在岗位门户内、不再跳转到其他应用，T079 强调一切都在门户内；目标保留站内收藏与跟踪，未指定具体交互。
supported_parts: 动作：收藏/记录岗位以便稍后跟踪

G024.target_statement: Keep the stakeholder's applications private so that others cannot see which roles were applied for.
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 原句明确不希望他人知道所申请岗位，并以'everything private'加强；范围为申请可见性，未扩展到账号安全等其他隐私维度。

G025.target_statement: Keep the stakeholder's data from being exposed to people or platforms outside the job platform.
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原句同时表达不希望站外平台联系与数据被平台外的人获取；两分句同指'数据不流出平台'，合并为一个结果，未增加技术手段。
supported_parts: 结果：数据不向平台外暴露

G026.target_statement: Require the stakeholder to verify AI-drafted application content instead of sending it automatically.
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: T095 给出条件式接受（经我们核验才可以）与明确禁止（不应自动），T093 说明理由（写作上不确定、不可靠）；否定与强度均保留。

G027.target_statement: See the status of each submitted application.
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: T105 以 10/10 的重要性并明确'想知道申请状态'，T111 再次希望可跟踪这些状态；两处同指申请状态可见，未推断状态种类或更新频率。
supported_parts: 对象：已提交申请的状态

G028.target_statement: Receive feedback on applications that helps improve further applications.
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: 原句明确希望获得反馈用于改进后续申请；T107 抱怨门户普遍不给反馈属动机背景，未把'雇主必须回复'写成硬性要求。

G029.target_statement: Show the job description and the responsibilities in separate UI sections.
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: 原句以 'if we can' 提出把岗位描述与职责分成两个 UI 区域；建议强度保留，未指定具体版式或必做程度。
supported_parts: 方式：按内容分区展示 UI
